Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event

Interface MigrationListener

public interface MigrationListener
Observes what a Migrator does, as Laravel's migration events do, plus a failure event.

Every method has an empty default, so a listener overrides only what it needs. Register one with Migrator.Builder.listener(MigrationListener); listeners are called in registration order on the thread that runs the migrator.

What a throwing listener does depends on the event:

  • migrationsStarted(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationsEvent) and migrationStarted(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationEvent): the exception stops the call before that work starts. Migrations that already finished stay applied and recorded.
  • migrationEnded(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationEvent), migrationSkipped(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationEvent), migrationsEnded(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationsEvent) and noPendingMigrations(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationsEvent): the exception propagates after the work it reports is done and recorded, so the migrations table stays correct. The call ends there.
  • migrationFailed(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationEvent, java.lang.Throwable): the exception is added as suppressed to the MigrationFailedException that is thrown, and the remaining listeners still run.

A failed migration ends the call with migrationFailed(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationEvent, java.lang.Throwable); migrationsEnded(org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.event.MigrationsEvent) is not called then. Events of a pretend call carry MigrationEvent.isPretend() and are fired outside the pretend scope, so statements a listener runs are not collected.

    • migrationFailed

      default void migrationFailed(MigrationEvent event, Throwable failure)
      Called when a migration, or the record of it, failed, just before the failure is thrown.

      It is not called for the first attempt of a migration that is run again with foreign-key enforcement off, only if the second attempt fails.

      Parameters:
      event - the migration, never null
      failure - the MigrationFailedException about to be thrown, never null
